scientific_integrity: Exact projection formula and two rigorously derived asymptotic equivalents, supported by separately evaluated deterministic quadrature and symbolic moment identities. Prior mean-density and covariance-front results are credited; priority remains subject to independent literature review.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to hydrodynamic Thomas–Fermi macroscopic density and stationary common Poisson reset-age fluctuations, only over the initial support. It does not describe microscopic quantum noise, finite particle corrections, other renewal clocks or a unique transition rate.
title: A spatial quiet point for reset-age fluctuations in an expanding Thomas–Fermi condensate
